test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

A. DATE: EXWH

B. READ: SFBE

C. FISH: GJTI

D. BOOK: CPPL

E. CARD: DBSE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

A. DATE: EXWH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b83c4f81fbb7650d2d190ea19ca64bbf9e9376b1a8e08f05183e46b1ef092e5.png] 

B. READ: SFBE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/700785558ec4acece13b8cad71bf073efa4637a5abffbe7a17f6396456229b77.png] 

C. FISH: GJTI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8291ac91b2916bf5279a2156f27e4f57c62bb89b26639a9f91ca324b93c041.png] 

D. BOOK: CPPL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c433278ba6c765e054b76c22aef6f8c86839ff2f07edded083036fb8e96aad0b.png] 

E. CARD: DBSE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddcc11cb4c7f74ab391b93a0aabe5fcbf9eb0573f7d2c456b5f8ece549545635.png] 

Thus, out of all "DATE: EXWH" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
